title: Custom-field reports
subtitle: Explore numeric and date fields using only documents visible to your Paperless account.
chooseField: Choose a numeric or date field...
sumHelp: Use for additive values such as invoice amounts. Values are summed once per matching document.
snapshotHelp: Use for balances or measurements. Only the latest value in each group is shown; groups must not be added together.
empty: No usable values match this report.
nonAdditive: Snapshot values are non-additive. Do not total the groups.
readOnly: Reports and CSV exports are read-only.
unsupported: No numeric or date custom fields are available.
